patch.title: Material clarity integration
patch.description: Admitted current-main integration packet: docs/planning/UIQ-04-INTEGRATION-ADMISSION.md; goal: docs/planning/UIQ-04-GOAL.md. Mount the immutable native material clarity panel in a collapsed inspector disclosure behind embedded uiq_material.
patch.expectation: Clearly distinguish existing material/ease guidance from screen-only color, texture and shine without changing behavior, saved state, validation, pattern, exports or physical claims.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepted UIQ-04 component source, CSS and tests match docs/research/uiq-clarity/CANDIDATE-EXIT.json exactly.
Embedded uiq_material is default-on with local test override; off, unknown, and stale preserve the exact pre-integration app shell and existing controls.
Snapshot uses only existing selected fabric, already-rendered ease note, color and appearance. Compatibility remains explicitly unknown; no drafting or renderer logic is added.
Review fabric and Review appearance focus existing controls without changing selection, appearance, persistence, revision, journey or output.
Changed production code and the settled repository pass 100% statement, branch, function and line coverage; build/typecheck, operational, export-byte-identity and protected-output gates pass.
Actual mounted browser, accessibility/media, narrow/zoom, no-egress, flag-off fallback and supported packaged verification evidence are attached.
Codex independently reviews and merges only after every gate passes; Slice 740 verifies main deployment and closes UIQ-04. UIQ-05/07 remain Backlog.
